message.content: Buddhism was founded by **Siddhārtha Gautama**, commonly known as the **Buddha** (“the awakened one”). He was born around the 5th–6th century BCE in Lumbini, which is today located in southern Nepal. After attaining enlightenment under the Bodhi tree near Bodh Gaya (in present‑day Bihar, India), he taught his insights throughout the Indian subcontinent. Thus, Buddhism originated in **ancient India**—specifically in the region that now spans parts of modern Nepal and northern India.

So we should say: It originated in ancient India, in the region of modern-day Nepal and northern India. Provide details. Also mention that the Buddha was born in Lumbini, present-day Nepal.
